summary: Yemeni armed forces conducted missile and drone strikes on three Saudi military bases in Jizan and Asir, claiming dozens of casualties and destruction of ammunition depots. Turkey is reportedly preparing military deployments to Saudi Arabia under a 'Mecca Defense Coalition' to counter Ansarallah. Satellite imagery indicates renewed activity at Iran's Minzadeh nuclear complex northeast of Tehran following its March 2026 destruction by Israel.
key_points: Yemeni forces struck Saudi bases Al-Dagharir (Jizan), Akfa (Asir), and Al-Mawsim (Jizan) with ballistic missiles and drones, claiming dozens of Saudi casualties and ammo depot destruction. (Source: @SharghDaily/187909)

Turkey plans to send military equipment, technicians, and emergency teams to Saudi Arabia under a 'Mecca Defense Coalition' for operations against Yemen's Ansarallah, with potential follow-on deployments of fighters and special forces. (Source: @kianmeli1/93039)

Satellite images show renewed vehicle traffic and earthworks at Iran's Minzadeh nuclear weapons development complex northeast of Tehran, suggesting efforts to rebuild capability after Israel's March 2026 strike. (Source: @asafroz/54106)

Israeli military, police, and Shin Bet chiefs held a joint multi-arena assessment ahead of elections, agreeing on steps to bolster defense against terror and nationalist crime. (Source: @pkpoi/144191)
Yemeni air defenses downed a Saudi CH-4 armed reconnaissance drone over Al-Jawf governorate during hostile missions. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92792)
Iraqi federal police suffered casualties and lost thermal cameras in an attack on a police position in Kirkuk province. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92757)
Gaza Health Ministry warns Israeli claims of militant presence in hospitals are fabricated pretexts to justify attacks on remaining healthcare facilities. (Source: @presstv/209791)
UK police arrested a 22-year-old British citizen suspected of involvement in preparing an Iranian terrorist attack on RAF Fairford base. (Source: @asafroz/54102)

points: Satellite imagery from September-October 2026 reveals renewed vehicle activity and earthworks at the Minzadeh nuclear weapons development complex northeast of Tehran, indicating possible Iranian efforts to reconstitute nuclear weapons capability after Israel's March 3, 2026 strike destroyed buildings and likely underground infrastructure. (Source: @asafroz/54106)

British police arrested a 22-year-old UK citizen on suspicion of involvement in preparing an Iranian terrorist attack targeting RAF Fairford base, highlighting ongoing Iranian external operations plotting. (Source: @asafroz/54102)

An unmarked Boeing 747 freighter was tracked over Tabriz, East Azerbaijan Province, heading west at 0948Z, suggesting covert air transport activity possibly linked to Iranian logistics. (Source: @shin_persian/10814)

U.S. President Trump stated regarding Iran: "We must end this; the question is how, soon you'll discover how we'll end it with Iran," signaling potential escalation of U.S. pressure. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92759)

IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir, Police Commissioner Danny Levy, and Shin Bet Chief David Zini conducted a joint multi-arena intelligence assessment ahead of upcoming elections, agreeing on coordinated steps to strengthen multi-front defense, counterterrorism, and combat nationalist crime. (Source: @pkpoi/144191)

Israeli forces announced expected explosion noises from own operations in northern Gaza envelope areas including Sha'ar HaNegev, Hof Ashkelon, and Sderot during early morning hours. (Source: @pkpoi/144193)

Hebrew newspaper Maariv reports conclusive military assessments indicate Israel is on the verge of a military operation on one of the region's fronts, though the specific front is not identified. (Source: @kianmeli1/93037)
IDF published a three-year retrospective of operational data across all arenas, force posture, and lessons learned since the October 7 attacks. (Source: @idf_telegram/25301)

Palestinian Health Ministry in Gaza warns that Israeli allegations of armed fighters or weapons in medical facilities are deliberate fabrications designed to justify further attacks on the Strip's devastated healthcare system. (Source: @presstv/209791)
PressTV correspondent Ahmed al-Najjar reports from Khan Yunis that Israel continues to weaponize basic survival needs three years into the conflict. (Source: @presstv/209798)
Footage circulated showing Gaza civilians celebrating the October 7 anniversary, described by the channel as "uninvolved civilians" marking the event. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94529)
Artillery shelling reported in Wadi Al Saluqi and Nabatieh Al Fawqa areas, with live map tracking indicating ongoing bombardment in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/46840, @redlinkleb/46814)
Warplanes active in the western sector of southern Lebanon per live map updates, suggesting Israeli Air Force operations in the area. (Source: @redlinkleb/46818)
Enemy vehicle movement observed in the town of Hadatha accompanied by machine gun sweeping fire, indicating ground clashes or reconnaissance along the border. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/397624)

Iraqi federal police personnel wounded and thermal cameras destroyed in an attack on a federal police position in Kirkuk province, indicating ongoing anti-government or ISIS activity. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92757)
